
```{r}
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(lme4)
library(sjPlot)
library(marginaleffects)
```

```{r}
# Fitted models are cached in output/turn_bc_models/; set refit_models <- TRUE to refit
model_dir <- here("output", "turn_bc_models")
dir.create(model_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
refit_models <- FALSE

fit_or_load <- function(name, expr) {
  path <- file.path(model_dir, paste0(name, ".rds"))
  if (!refit_models && file.exists(path)) {
    readRDS(path)
  } else {
    model <- expr
    saveRDS(model, path)
    model
  }
}
```


```{r}
sbc <- readRDS(here("data", 'turns_updated.rds'))
back_given_place_summ <- read_csv(here("data", 'conditional_back_summary.csv'))
```


```{r}
sbc <- sbc %>% left_join(back_given_place_summ, by = c(text = "word", "place"))
```

```{r}
sbc_noninit <- sbc %>%
  mutate(has_overlap_onset = str_detect(transcript, "\\[")) %>%
  filter(place != 1) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_back))
```


# Divide into BC or not


```{r}
# Opening-bracket label of each word, e.g. "[" or "[2" (NA if none)
sbc <- sbc %>%
  mutate(overlap_label = str_extract(transcript, "\\[\\d*"))

# Next two units (within the same doc), their turnTypes, and whether the next has any overlap
unit_info <- sbc %>%
  group_by(docId, unitId) %>%
  summarise(
    unit_turnType = first(turnType),
    unit_has_overlap = any(isOverlap %in% TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(docId, unitId) %>%
  group_by(docId) %>%
  mutate(
    next_unitId = lead(unitId),
    next_turnType = lead(unit_turnType),
    next_has_overlap = lead(unit_has_overlap),
    next2_unitId = lead(unitId, 2),
    next2_turnType = lead(unit_turnType, 2)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    docId,
    unitId,
    next_unitId,
    next_turnType,
    next_has_overlap,
    next2_unitId,
    next2_turnType
  )

# Opening brackets in each unit, keyed so they can be matched from an earlier unit
open_brackets <- sbc %>%
  filter(!is.na(overlap_label)) %>%
  distinct(docId, unitId, overlap_label)

sbc <- sbc %>%
  left_join(unit_info, by = c("docId", "unitId")) %>%
  left_join(
    open_brackets %>% mutate(next_has_match = TRUE),
    by = c("docId", next_unitId = "unitId", "overlap_label")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    open_brackets %>% mutate(next2_has_match = TRUE),
    by = c("docId", next2_unitId = "unitId", "overlap_label")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    next_has_match = coalesce(next_has_match, FALSE),
    # Only look two units ahead if the next unit has some (other) overlapped portion
    next2_has_match = !next_has_match &
      coalesce(next_has_overlap, FALSE) &
      coalesce(next2_has_match, FALSE),
    has_overlap_onset = next_has_match | next2_has_match,
    match_turnType = if_else(next_has_match, next_turnType, next2_turnType),
    has_bc_onset = has_overlap_onset &
      coalesce(str_detect(match_turnType, "^\\s*back"), FALSE),
    # Only full, minimal or terminated (abandoned) turns; laughter, vocalisations etc. are neither
    has_turn_onset = has_overlap_onset &
      coalesce(str_detect(match_turnType, "^\\s*(full|minimal|terminated)"), FALSE)
  ) %>%
  select(
    -c(
      next_unitId,
      next_turnType,
      next_has_overlap,
      next2_unitId,
      next2_turnType,
      next_has_match,
      next2_has_match,
      match_turnType
    )
  )

# Whether any word in the turn has a BC / turn onset (NA where turnSeq is missing)
sbc <- sbc %>%
  group_by(docId, turnSeq) %>%
  mutate(
    turn_has_bc_onset = if_else(is.na(turnSeq), NA, any(has_bc_onset)),
    turn_has_turn_onset = if_else(is.na(turnSeq), NA, any(has_turn_onset))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
sbc_noninit <- sbc %>%
  filter(place != 1) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_back))
```


```{r}
model_overlap_on_modeback_bc <- fit_or_load(
  "model_overlap_on_modeback_bc",
  glmer(
    has_bc_onset ~ mode_back + place + (1 | docId),
    data = sbc_noninit %>% filter(turn_has_bc_onset),
    family = binomial(link = "logit")
  )
)
model_overlap_on_modeback_turn <- fit_or_load(
  "model_overlap_on_modeback_turn",
  glmer(
    has_turn_onset ~ mode_back + place + (1 | docId),
    data = sbc_noninit %>% filter(turn_has_turn_onset),
    family = binomial(link = "logit")
  )
)
```


```{r}
plot_predictions(
  model_overlap_on_modeback_bc,

) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, .03))

plot_predictions(
  model_overlap_on_modeback_turn,
  condition = list("mode_back")
) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, .03))
```

# Mode back vs actual back

```{r}
# Same rows for every model so AIC / LRTs are comparable
sbc_back <- sbc_noninit %>%
  filter(!is.na(back), !is.na(mode_back))
```


Mode back vs actual back (non-nested, so compare AIC):

```{r}
AIC(model_bc_place_modeback, model_bc_place_back)

```

Does mode back add anything over place + actual back (nested, so LRT):

Adding a quadratic place effect to the full interaction models:

```{r}
model_bc_place_back_modeback_int_sq <- fit_or_load(
  "model_bc_place_back_modeback_int_sq",
  glmer(
    has_bc_onset ~ place * back + place * mode_back + I(place^2) + (1 | docId),
    data = sbc_back %>% filter(turn_has_bc_onset),
    family = binomial(link = "logit")
  )
)
model_turn_place_back_modeback_int_sq <- fit_or_load(
  "model_turn_place_back_modeback_int_sq",
  glmer(
    has_turn_onset ~ place * back + place * mode_back + I(place^2) + (1 | docId),
    data = sbc_back %>% filter(turn_has_turn_onset),
    family = binomial(link = "logit")
  )
)
```

Does the quadratic place term help (nested, so LRT):

# Back prediction error

```{r}
# Positive = more words left in the unit than the mode predicts
sbc_back <- sbc_back %>%
  mutate(back_err = back - mode_back)
```

```{r}
model_bc_place_backerr <- fit_or_load(
  "model_bc_place_backerr",
  glmer(
    has_bc_onset ~ place + back_err + (1 | docId),
    data = sbc_back %>% filter(turn_has_bc_onset),
    family = binomial(link = "logit")
  )
)
# Same fit as place + back + mode_back, reparameterised
model_bc_place_modeback_backerr <- fit_or_load(
  "model_bc_place_modeback_backerr",
  glmer(
    has_bc_onset ~ place + mode_back + back_err + (1 | docId),
    data = sbc_back %>% filter(turn_has_bc_onset),
    family = binomial(link = "logit")
  )
)
```

```{r}
model_turn_place_backerr <- fit_or_load(
  "model_turn_place_backerr",
  glmer(
    has_turn_onset ~ place + back_err + (1 | docId),
    data = sbc_back %>% filter(turn_has_turn_onset),
    family = binomial(link = "logit")
  )
)
# Same fit as place + back + mode_back, reparameterised
model_turn_place_modeback_backerr <- fit_or_load(
  "model_turn_place_modeback_backerr",
  glmer(
    has_turn_onset ~ place + mode_back + back_err + (1 | docId),
    data = sbc_back %>% filter(turn_has_turn_onset),
    family = binomial(link = "logit")
  )
)
```

Prediction error vs mode back vs actual back (non-nested, so compare AIC):

```{r}
AIC(model_bc_place_backerr, model_bc_place_modeback, model_bc_place_back)
AIC(model_turn_place_backerr, model_turn_place_modeback, model_turn_place_back)
```

Does prediction error add anything over place + mode back (nested, so LRT):

# Non-terminal IUs only

Drop IUs ending in terminal intonation (period or question mark), to see if the effects are about IU boundaries rather than utterance boundaries.

```{r}
# endNote sits on the IU's punctuation row (place is NA there), so flag at the unit level
unit_terminal <- sbc %>%
  group_by(docId, unitId) %>%
  summarise(
    unit_is_terminal = any(endNote %in% c("final", "appeal")),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sbc_back_nonterm <- sbc_back %>%
  left_join(unit_terminal, by = c("docId", "unitId")) %>%
  filter(!unit_is_terminal)
```

```{r}
model_bc_place_modeback_nonterm <- fit_or_load(
```

# Syntactically incomplete IUs only

Drop IUs that end at a possible sentence end, using the spaCy dependency parses. An IU counts as incomplete if, at its last word, something is still due:

- a word so far is waiting for its head (e.g. "the", a subject before its verb),
- a later word fills a core argument slot of a word so far (e.g. "to get / something"), or
- the IU ends in a dangling function word (e.g. "and", "or", a preposition with no object).

```{r}
# Later dependents that count as a "due" argument of an earlier head
core_deps <- c(
  "dobj",
  "pobj",
  "pcomp",
  "attr",
  "acomp",
  "oprd",
  "dative",
  "xcomp",
  "ccomp",
  "nsubj",
  "nsubjpass",
  "csubj"
)
# IU-final dependency labels that leave the IU hanging
dangling_deps <- c(
  "cc",
  "preconj",
  "prep",
  "det",
  "predet",
  "poss",
  "mark",
  "aux",
  "auxpass",
  "case"
)
# Subject labels, for subjects still waiting for their verb
subj_deps <- c("nsubj", "nsubjpass", "csubj", "csubjpass", "expl")

parses <- list.files(
  here("data", "new_spacy_parses"),
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
) %>%
  lapply(\(f) {
    read_csv(
      f,
      col_select = c(docId, unitId, text, spacy_id, head, dep),
      show_col_types = FALSE
    )
  }) %>%
  bind_rows()

# spacy_id and head are token indices running through the whole doc
parse_tokens <- parses %>%
  filter(!is.na(spacy_id), dep != "punct") %>%
  arrange(docId, spacy_id) %>%
  group_by(docId) %>%
  mutate(
    head = as.numeric(head),
    max_head_so_far = cummax(head),
    max_subj_head_so_far = cummax(if_else(dep %in% subj_deps, head, -Inf)),
    core_head = if_else(dep %in% core_deps, head, Inf),
    # Smallest head among core dependents strictly after this token
    min_core_head_after = lead(rev(cummin(rev(core_head))), default = Inf)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

iu_syntax <- parse_tokens %>%
  group_by(docId, unitId) %>%
  mutate(iu_text = paste(text, collapse = " ")) %>%
  slice_max(spacy_id, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    docId,
    unitId,
    iu_text,
    head_due = max_head_so_far > spacy_id,
    # Subset of head_due: a subject so far whose verb comes after the IU
    verb_due = max_subj_head_so_far > spacy_id,
    arg_due = min_core_head_after <= spacy_id,
    dangling = dep %in% dangling_deps,
    iu_possible_end = !(head_due | arg_due | dangling)
  )
```

Sanity check: how the flag lines up with intonation, and some examples.

```{r}
iu_syntax %>%
  left_join(unit_terminal, by = c("docId", "unitId")) %>%
  count(unit_is_terminal, iu_possible_end)

iu_syntax %>%
  slice_sample(n = 40) %>%
  select(iu_text, head_due, verb_due, arg_due, dangling, iu_possible_end)
```

```{r}
sbc_back_incompl <- sbc_back %>%
  inner_join(
    iu_syntax %>% select(docId, unitId, iu_possible_end),
    by = c("docId", "unitId")
  ) %>%
  filter(!iu_possible_end)
```

# Excluding only IUs that are both syntactically and prosodically complete

Drop IUs that end at a possible sentence end *and* in terminal intonation (period or question mark); keep everything else.

```{r}
sbc_back_notboth <- sbc_back %>%
  left_join(unit_terminal, by = c("docId", "unitId")) %>%
  left_join(
    iu_syntax %>% select(docId, unitId, iu_possible_end),
    by = c("docId", "unitId")
  ) %>%
  # Unparsed IUs (NA) are kept
  filter(!(unit_is_terminal %in% TRUE & iu_possible_end %in% TRUE))

sbc_back_notboth %>%
  summarise(
    n_words = n(),
    n_ius = n_distinct(docId, unitId),
    n_bc_onsets = sum(has_bc_onset & turn_has_bc_onset, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_turn_onsets = sum(has_turn_onset & turn_has_turn_onset, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
